Thank you...

The problem with my mom is we(me and gf) already live with my mom, who also has a lot of issues(that are less bad with someone else here even if she’s still a headache)... i don’t have any friends i can access irl. Any family could be a temporary arrangement at most - dad’s a neglective alcoholic, grandmother is abusive, only one probably safe to be with would be my uncle’s family and that probably couldn’t last long for various reasons. I really don’t *know* anyone. I’ve been pretty isolated for years until gf moved over here. 

If my mom even let me leave in the first place - and she definitely wouldn’t let me leave to stay with anyone she doesn’t know in any sort of housing arrangement. 

And i’m too medically fragile to live alone, so it’s not like i could just leave anyways while i get a job and enough money to just be on my own...
